title: Shared GPU Traffic Warden
subtitle: Lets requests into the small model only when the card has measured free memory, and otherwise answers "busy, try again in this many seconds" instead of crashing the large model.
lede: Lets requests into the small model only when the card has measured free memory, and otherwise answers "busy, try again in this many seconds" instead of crashing the large model.
